content.json:
# Arc - SQL Server Monitoring Workbook

This workbook provides comprehensive insights into your Arc-enabled SQL Server estate, including inventory, configuration, security, and compliance status.

---

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances/databases"
| summarize 
    Databases=count(),
    OfflineDBs=sum(toint(iif(tostring(properties["state"]) != "Online", 1, 0))),
    TotalSizeMB=sum(toint(iif(tostring(properties["sizeMB"]) != "", properties["sizeMB"], 0))) 
    by Instance = tostring(split(tostring(id), "/")[8])
| extend TotalSizeGB = round(TotalSizeMB / 1024.0, 2)
| project Instance, Databases, OfflineDBs, TotalSizeGB
| order by TotalSizeGB desc 
| take 20
content.title: Database Details per SQL Server Instance
content.subtitle: Top 20 instances by database size

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances/databases"
| summarize Count=count() by CompatibilityLevel=tostring(properties['compatibilityLevel'])
| order by Count desc
content.title: Database Compatibility Levels
content.subtitle: Distribution of database compatibility levels

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
| summarize Count=count() by LicenseType=tostring(properties['licenseType'])
| order by Count desc
content.title: License Distribution
content.subtitle: Distribution of SQL Server license types

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
| summarize Count=count() by DefenderStatus=iff(tostring(properties['azureDefenderStatus'])=="Unknown", "Not Protected", tostring(properties['azureDefenderStatus']))
| order by Count desc
content.title: Azure Defender for SQL Server
content.subtitle: Protection status distribution

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances/databases"
| summarize Count=count() by Encrypted=iif(tostring(properties['databaseOptions'].isEncrypted)=="false", "No", "Yes")
content.title: Database Encryption Status
content.subtitle: Encrypted vs non-encrypted databases

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
| project 
    InstanceName = name,
    ResourceGroup = resourceGroup,
    Edition = tostring(properties['edition']),
    Version = tostring(properties['version']),
    LicenseType = tostring(properties['licenseType']),
    vCoreCount = toint(properties['vCore']),
    Location = location
| order by LicenseType, Edition, InstanceName
content.title: License Details per Instance
content.subtitle: Detailed licensing information for all instances

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
| mv-expand bagexpansion=array tags
| summarize Count=count() by tostring(tags[0])
| order by Count desc
| take 10
content.title: Top 10 Tag Keys
content.subtitle: Most commonly used tag keys

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
| summarize Count=count() by Edition=tostring(properties['edition'])
| order by Count desc
content.title: SQL Server Editions
content.subtitle: Distribution by SQL Server edition

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
| where isnotempty(tags['Environment'])
| summarize Count=count() by Environment=tostring(tags['Environment'])
| order by Count desc
content.title: Environment Distribution
content.subtitle: Instances by environment tag

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances/databases"
    | summarize 
        DatabaseCount=count(),
        TotalSizeGB=round(sum(toint(iif(tostring(properties['sizeMB']) != "", properties['sizeMB'], 0))) / 1024.0, 2)
        by InstanceId = tostring(split(tostring(id), "/databases/")[0])
) on $left.id == $right.InstanceId
| project 
    InstanceName = name,
    ResourceGroup = resourceGroup,
    Location = location,
    Version = tostring(properties['version']),
    Edition = tostring(properties['edition']),
    LicenseType = tostring(properties['licenseType']),
    DefenderStatus = tostring(properties['azureDefenderStatus']),
    DatabaseCount = iif(isempty(DatabaseCount), 0, DatabaseCount),
    TotalSizeGB = iif(isempty(TotalSizeGB), 0.0, TotalSizeGB)
| order by DatabaseCount desc, TotalSizeGB desc
content.title: Complete SQL Server Analysis
content.subtitle: Comprehensive view of all Arc-enabled SQL Server instances with database information
